```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(glmnet)
library(rpart)
library(rpart.plot)
library(broom)
```

```{r generate-data}
set.seed(2024)
n <- 200; p <- 50
X <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
colnames(X) <- paste0("V", 1:p)
y <- 2 * X[, 1] - 1.5 * X[, 2] + rnorm(n)

data("diamonds", package = "ggplot2")
```
